evals.prompt: Show me all deferred work in this project.
evals.expected_output: Read-only ledger grouped by file. Each entry has file:line, tier (explicit/likely/weak), note, and ref. Totals line at end with breakdown by tier. No edits proposed.
assertions: Output contains at least one entry in format '<file>:<line> [<tier>] — <note>'
Output ends with a totals line showing explicit/likely/weak counts
No edit or cleanup actions are performed, only reporting

evals.prompt: duck debt strict mode — only show issue-linked entries
evals.expected_output: Ledger filtered to explicit tier only (entries with issue links like #123 or PROJECT-NNN). Strict mode totals line. If no issue-linked entries exist, reports clean ledger.
assertions: Only entries with tier [explicit] appear in output
No [likely] or [weak] tier entries in output
Totals line uses strict format: 'totals: <N> entries (strict: issue-linked only)'
If no explicit entries, output contains 'Clean ledger'

evals.prompt: Audit deferred simplification debt in this project.
evals.expected_output: Skill asks one clarifying question about scope (which module/directory) before scanning. Does not produce ledger without scope clarification first.
assertions: Asks at least one clarifying question about scope or module before scanning
Does not produce full ledger output before user answers scope question

evals.prompt: List the TODO/FIXME/HACK entries in this repo and then clean them up for me.
evals.expected_output: Produces read-only ledger first. When asked to clean up, proposes handoff to duck-review then duck-patch rather than editing directly. Does not perform edits.
assertions: Ledger output is produced as read-only
Cleanup request is redirected to duck-review and/or duck-patch
